description: Change which version is online and who can open it. A call changes only the fields it names. With version, puts that version online; without it, changes only access to the live publication and retries failed invitations.

access.description: Who can open the project. Without it, access stays as it is.

mode.description: Required for the first publication unless an audience is already set; otherwise only to change it.

notify.description: Default true. Set false to give access without invitation emails.

password.description: For the password audience: at least 8 characters. Without it, Sharekite generates a password or keeps the existing one. A new password signs out current visitors.

recipients.description: Addresses added to the existing recipients. Restricted only.

project.description: The project key, such as client-report.

replaceVersion.description: Needed for a rollback: the version that is online now.

name: publish

password.description: Present only when no password was given and Sharekite generated one.

state.description: already_online: this call did not change which version is online.

title: Publish and share
